```{r}
value = c(1)
for (i in 1:10) {

  value <- value*i
}
value


```
```{r}
factorial <- function(value = 10) {
  if (value >= 100) stop 
  if (value < 100)
    factor <-c(1)
    for (i in 1:value) {
    factor <- factor*i
    return(factor)
    }}

factorial(value = 11)

```
```{r}
convert_cm_to_in <-function(cm, roundplace =2) {
  value = cm/2.54
  value <- round(value, digits =roundplace)
  return(value)
}

convert_cm_to_in(25)
convert_cm_to_in(c(1:100))
```


```{r}
count_my_change <- function(dollars = 0, quarters = 0, dimes =0, nickels =0, pennies = 0) {
  amount <- dollars + 0.25 * quarters + 0.1 * dimes + 0.05 * nickels + 0.01 * pennies
  return('Your total is $amount')}

count_my_change(1, 2)
```
